principle: DS v2 core tokens are the default. Supporting ramps are allowed only when they serve a documented reading or hierarchy job in dense documents, tables, data panels, or calibration artifacts.

black.role: Primary surface, heading ink, dark bookends, authority.

mid_black.role: Secondary bento cells against Black only.

deep_navy.role: Process, trust, Blueprint moments, featured Gold tier, method context.

red.role: Problem framing, urgency, primary action, risk/action emphasis.

white.role: Paper/canvas, text on dark, max-contrast CTA fill.

ice_blue.role: Text accent on Navy only. Never a fill.

grey_ramp.allowed_when: Dense light-surface documents, tables, footers, metadata, or exported formats where alpha black cannot be represented reliably.
grey_ramp.avoid_when: Marketing slides, website sections, or any place alpha black/white will render correctly.

steel_blue_ramp.allowed_when: Quiet operational accents, small labels on dark/navy, sub-list markers, or legacy reference-artifact calibration where Ice Blue is too bright.
steel_blue_ramp.avoid_when: Gold tier fills, CTA fills, large panels, or replacement for Navy process/trust surfaces.

red_tints.allowed_when: Severity nuance, secondary text on red surfaces, or risk tables where full Red would overpower body copy.
red_tints.avoid_when: Primary CTA, main problem accent, or large panel fills that should use core Red.

light_panel_fills.allowed_when: Dense print/PDF table fills, first-column emphasis, or low-contrast document panels where alpha fills are unavailable or unreliable.
light_panel_fills.avoid_when: Website cards, slide cards, decorative panels, or any layout where a DS v2 bento surface can carry hierarchy.

reference_dark_variants.allowed_when: PPTX template/reference calibration where the source deck uses a near-black or deep-navy export variant for stacked dark panels.
reference_dark_variants.avoid_when: New web/UI surfaces, primary DS v2 documentation, or replacement for core Black/Navy outside PPTX reference/template reproduction.
